exposure: labour commencement method (spontaneous onset of labour vs. induced onset of labour)
outcome: maternal satisfaction with care at birth
maternal birth experience at 8 weeks postpartum
maternal birth experience at 1 year postpartum
cohort: Pregnant women in late term (>= 41+0 to < 42+0 weeks gestational age) who gave birth in Sweden during 2020-2021.
finding: Women with spontaneous onset of labour reported higher satisfaction with care at birth and a more positive birth experience at both 8 weeks and 1 year postpartum compared to women with induced onset of labour.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a common factor influencing satisfaction with care and birth experience.
